# After-Delivery Undertakings by Programme: Warranty, Resizing, Protection and Uniqueness

Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions carry, by programme, the whole months the chain stands behind the commissioned piece after delivery, the calendar days after delivery within which one resizing is carried out without charge, whether a protection plan is included with the piece, whether the chain undertakes never to make the same piece for another customer, and the whole years it holds back from reproducing the design.

## Undertakings

| Programme | Warranty (months from delivery) | One free resizing within (calendar days of delivery) | Protection plan included | Unique piece guaranteed | Design not reproduced for (years) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting | 12 | 60 | no | no | 0 |
| Design Studio Custom Setting | 18 | 90 | no | no | 0 |
| Belrose Bespoke Design | 24 | 120 | yes | yes | 2 |
| Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission | 36 | 180 | yes | yes | 5 |
| Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission | 24 | 120 | yes | yes | 3 |
| Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission | 60 | 365 | yes | yes | 25 |

## Notes

- The two Design Studio programmes carry no unique piece guarantee and no reproduction restriction (0 years); every other programme guarantees a unique piece, for the years listed.
- A protection plan comes with the piece under Belrose Bespoke Design, the Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission, the Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission and the Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission, and not under either Design Studio programme.
- The free resizing window runs from 60 calendar days under the Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting to 365 under the Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission.
